text: Reads, writes, orders and rounds numbers to 1000, and to 10 000 where the school extends, including numbers below zero. Adds and subtracts 3-digit numbers mentally and in columns, recalls multiplication facts to 10 × 10, and multiplies and divides by a 1-digit number, checking with an estimate. Finds fractions of shapes, amounts and number lines, and uses money in rupees and paise. Solves problems of more than one step, and explains the rule behind a number pattern.
